newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates widen, one week down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates widen, one week down.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Egyptian pound widened on Wednesday in a bit short private sector market to 8-1/2 and 9-1/4 percent from between 8-3/4 and 9-1/8 percent on Monday, bankers said.
The Central Bank and state-owned banks were closed on Tuesday, marking the beginning of the fiscal year 1997/8 and almost completely stopping transactions.
The average of one-week rates fell to 9-1/8 percent from between 9-1/8 and 9-1/4 percent on Monday, the bankers added.
